KidsProgram.title: Free Jiu-Jitsu | Kids Group Ages 3–5
KidsProgram.description:
At Gladius, a special Pre Jiu-Jitsu  program has been created for children aged 3–5, where learning takes place through movement, games, and a positive environment.

The program is focused not only on physical development, but also on mental and emotional growth. Specially designed exercises improve motor skills, balance, coordination, concentration, and body control. At this age, particular attention is given to developing the harmonious cooperation of the brain’s left and right hemispheres, helping children improve quick thinking, focus, decision-making, and creativity.

In a safe and friendly environment, children are introduced to the basic elements of Jiu-Jitsu and Judo while also learning discipline, responsibility, listening skills, and positive behavior patterns.

Training sessions are conducted under the supervision of professional instructors, where every activity is designed to support the child’s physical, intellectual, and psychological development.

The mission of Gladius is to help children grow into healthy, confident, active, and disciplined individuals who can succeed both in sports and in life.

AdultsBjj.title: 6-14 Year - Children's Program
AdultsBjj.description:
For children aged 6–14, Gladius has developed a unique and comprehensive training program that combines Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with GI & NO-GI, Krav Maga, Judo fundamentals, sports psychology, coordination, and balance development.

The main goal of the program is not only to develop strong and technical athletes, but also to shape disciplined, confident, determined, and successful individuals. Training sessions are conducted under the supervision of professional instructors, sports psychologists, and physical development specialists, helping children develop leadership skills, teamwork, quick thinking and reaction, patience, emotional resilience, and a high level of discipline.

The mission of Gladius is to raise not only champions in sports, but strong individuals for life.

bjjYangAdults.title: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (GI / NO GI)
bjjYangAdults.description:
Gladius is one of the largest and most international Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academies in Georgia. Founded in 2014, it became the first academy in the country to professionally develop and systematically teach Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

The academy teaches both GI and NO-GI Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Gladius is the official representative of Gracie Barra in Georgia — one of the world’s most recognized Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu organizations. Belt promotions are conducted according to the official Gracie Barra curriculum and international certification standards.

All classes are conducted simultaneously in three languages — Georgian, English, and Russian — creating a truly international training environment. Today, athletes from 34 different nationalities train at Gladius, including both girls and boys, children and adults.

The academy’s international standard is strengthened by a multinational coaching team consisting of professional instructors from Georgia, Brazil, Azerbaijan, and Argentina.

The mission of Gladius is not only to build strong athletes and champions, but also to develop disciplined, confident, and successful individuals. Training helps students improve not only physical abilities, but also mental resilience, leadership, self-control, respect, teamwork, and fast decision-making skills.

Today, Gladius stands as one of the largest and fastest-growing martial arts academies in Georgia, where sport, education, discipline, and international experience come together in one place.

kravMaga.title: Krav Maga | Real Self-Defense for Real Situations
kravMaga.description:
At Gladius, Krav Maga is not just a martial art — it is a modern self-defense system designed for real-life situations, extreme conditions, and high-stress environments where fast, effective, and intelligent reactions are critical.

Training is conducted by professional military and tactical Krav Maga instructors with real operational and combat experience. The program is designed for both women and men, helping students develop not only self-defense skills, but also confidence, mental resilience, awareness, and quick decision-making abilities.

Our Krav Maga system is divided into two main directions:

🔹 Civilian Defensive Krav Maga — focused on realistic street self-defense, personal safety, protecting loved ones, conflict control, and escaping dangerous situations safely. The system is based on maximum effectiveness with minimum necessary damage.

🔹 Special & Tactical Krav Maga — an advanced tactical program for military personnel, security professionals, and representatives of special services. It includes tactical movement, operational response, combat scenarios, and specialized physical preparation. Offensive military Krav Maga is not taught to civilians unless they officially represent special units or security structures.

Gladius Krav Maga includes much more than self-defense techniques:

• Professional punching and kicking techniques
• Balance and coordination development
• CrossFit and tactical physical conditioning
• Endurance and speed training
• Fast reaction and situational analysis
• Mental toughness and stress management
• Tactical and team-based training

Our mission is to help every student become capable of protecting themselves while remaining calm, controlled, and confident under pressure.

At Gladius, Krav Maga means safety, strength, discipline, and readiness for real life.

Masterclass.title: MasterclassPrivate Training | Personalized Development for Maximum Results
Masterclass.description:
At Gladius, private training sessions are available for both children and adults in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (GI / NO-GI) and Krav Maga.

Each personal training program is fully customized according to the student’s goals, physical abilities, experience, and development pace. This approach allows students to improve technique, physical conditioning, mental resilience, and confidence much faster and more effectively.

Private sessions are especially effective for:

• Beginners — to learn techniques correctly and faster
• Professional athletes — preparing for competitions and high-level tournaments
• Children — developing discipline, concentration, and coordination
• Krav Maga students — improving real-life self-defense skills
• Physical fitness, endurance, and functional conditioning

Training is conducted under the supervision of professional instructors and includes technical, tactical, physical, and psychological preparation. Every program is individually designed to meet the athlete’s specific needs.

The cost of private training depends on:
• The athlete’s age
• Experience and skill level
• Training frequency
• Session duration and program specifics

Gladius private programs are designed for those who seek faster progress, maximum attention, and high-level results in a safe and professional environment.

About.aboutDescription: GLADIUS is a martial arts school located in Tbilisi, Georgia. We specialize in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Krav Maga, and MMA. Our experienced coaches are dedicated to providing high-quality training for all levels, from beginners to advanced practitioners. Coaches.title: Our Coaches
Coaches.coach1Role: Founder & Head Coach – Club Gladius | President of the Georgian Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu National Federation | Co-Founder of the Georgian Jiu-Jitsu Tour | Jiu-Jitsu Black Belt 2011–2025 (1st–6th Dan) | Since 2026 – Shihan | World Champion
Coaches.coach1Description:
Giorgi Oboladze is one of the pioneers of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Georgia and one of the leading figures in the development of this sport in the country. He was the first to begin the systematic development of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Georgia and founded a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy in 2014. Since 2023, he has served as the President of the Georgian Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu National Federation and is one of the founders of the Georgian Jiu-Jitsu Tour (2022) — a platform that has played a significant role in establishing a professional and competitive Jiu-Jitsu environment in Georgia.

In 2014, Giorgi Oboladze founded Club Gladius, which today is recognized as one of the leading combat sports academies in Georgia. As the head coach, he has developed a high-level technical, physical, and mental training system based on discipline, strategy, and continuous improvement.

Giorgi Oboladze holds a 6th Dan Black Belt in Jiu-Jitsu and is a World Champion in Japanese Jiu-Jitsu, as well as the winner of numerous international tournaments. He is a professional Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu instructor, a professional instructor of the special Krav Maga program, and the author of implementing this system within the educational field. He has many years of experience in special physical preparation and tactical professional training.

Alongside his sporting career, he serves as the Chief Specialist for Construction, Standardization, and Occupational Safety at SOCAR Georgia Gas nationwide. Giorgi Oboladze holds higher education degrees and is currently a doctoral candidate. His professional activity combines athletic achievements, instruction, and strategic leadership, making him one of the leading figures in combat sports in Georgia.

Facility.title: Our Space
Facility.subtitle:
Gladius Academy was founded on September 30, 2014, and today represents one of the largest, most successful, and dynamically developing martial arts centers in Georgia. The founder and head coach of the academy is Giorgi Oboladze — President of the Georgian Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu National Federation, holder of a 5th Dan in Jiu-Jitsu, and a professional Krav Maga instructor.

Gladius Academy is a space where sport goes beyond physical training and becomes a way of life. Here, discipline, character, responsibility, and a winning mentality are developed. The academy объединяет various martial arts disciplines: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Krav Maga (street self-defense), Japanese Jiu-Jitsu, Judo, and MMA, providing comprehensive development for both professional athletes and beginners.

Special attention is dedicated to children’s development. The academy operates groups for children aged 3–5 called “Free Jiu-Jitsu,” where children learn discipline, order, motor skills, coordination, harmonious physical and mental development, as well as the basics of sports psychology. In the 6–14 age groups, the focus is placed on discipline, psychological resilience, responsibility, and teamwork. The main mission of Gladius Academy is not only to raise strong athletes, but also to shape strong, disciplined, and successful citizens.

Since 2014, the academy has trained hundreds of athletes and today stands as one of the largest academies in Georgia by number of students. Highly qualified instructors from different countries — Georgia, Brazil, Spain, Argentina, and Azerbaijan — are involved in the training process, creating a unique international environment. All training sessions are conducted in three languages: Georgian, English, and Russian.

The philosophy of the academy is based on the holistic development of the individual — the unity of physical, mental, and psychological growth. Special attention is given to sports psychology, motor skill development, balance, and coordination — the foundations that determine both athletic and life success.

Gladius Academy actively cooperates with Georgian universities, schools, and various organizations in order to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage youth involvement in sports. The academy systematically participates in sports and social projects organized by both the public and private sectors, making an important contribution to the development of society.

Today, Gladius Academy represents not only a sports center, but also a powerful platform for shaping the next generation — a place where leaders grow, character is built, and champions are born.

Gladius Academy — the largest, strongest, and most result-oriented martial arts space in Georgia.
